The struct is defined in `store/memo.go`. The `Driver` interface in `store/driver.go` uses `*Memo` for create/list operations. Each dialect maps SQL rows into `store.Memo` in its `memo.go`. API handlers mostly convert or pass `*store.Memo` (for example `convertMemoFromStore` in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go`). Files like `memo_service_comments.go`, `fileserver/fileserver.go`, and `user_service_stats.go` use `store.Memo` values returned from `GetMemo`/`ListMemos` without always naming the type explicitly.
